card.name: Scattered words in news and policy prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on assorted words (between, making, coverage, to, across, For) in general web articles on politics, international affairs and social topics.

modes.label: Connecting words
modes.description: Short linking words such as between, to, across or For in news-style sentences.
modes.example: a 17-year legal battle <<between>> the NFL franchise and a group of indigenous

modes.label: Content words in world-affairs text
modes.description: Nouns or verbs like making or coverage in articles on international topics.
modes.example: This post is part of our International Relations & Security <<coverage>>.

card.plain: It reacts to a mix of ordinary words in news and world-affairs writing, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
